title: Average-case multidimensional pattern matching

problem.name: Average-case multidimensional pattern matching
problem.statement_latex: Given arrays $T:[n]^d\to\Sigma$ and $P:[m]^d\to\Sigma$, find an offset $s$ with $T(s+x)=P(x)$ for every $x\in[m]^d$. The theorem assumes the paper's random-input distribution and fixed dimension $d$; complexity counts queries and time.
problem.statement_text: Given arrays $T:[n]^d\to\Sigma$ and $P:[m]^d\to\Sigma$, find an offset $s$ with $T(s+x)=P(x)$ for every $x\in[m]^d$. The theorem assumes the paper's random-input distribution and fixed dimension $d$; complexity counts queries and time.

strength.description_latex: Exponential to subexponential in the strongest stated regime; the general parameter dependence is retained above.
